1: We Are Pictures, or Mere Beasts
Unmask Her Beauty to the Moon
The Slings and Arrows of Outrageous Fortune
In My Heart There Was a Kind of Fighting
Our Wills and Fates Do So Contrary Run
2: It Is Not, Nor It Cannot Come to Good
Is Not This Something More Than Fantasy?
What, Has This Thing Appear'd Again Tonight?
The Spirit That I Have Seen
Doubt Truth to Be a Liar
Taint Not Thy Mind, Nor Let Thy Soul Contrive Against Thy Mother
And Then It Started Like a Guilty Thing
The Serpent That Did Sting Thy Father's Life
3: More Than Kin, and Less Than Kind
The Counterfeit Presentment of Two Brothers
In the Same Figure, Like the King That's Dead
To Show My Duty in Your Coronation
4: Seek for Thy Noble Father in the Dust
Black as His Purpose Did the Night Resemble
My News Shall Be the Fruit to That Great Feast
In the Dead Vast and Middle of the Night
With Mirth in Funeral and With Dirge in Marriage
